flaws.description: Swapped the numeric value lists assigned to the 'Time to Comply (Hours)' and 'Post-Compliance Hours' keys in the data dictionary, so the x and y axes now plot each other's true values while the axis labels, colors, and legend remain unchanged.
Changed the Regulatory Burden value for 2013 from 790 to 1264 (approximately 1.6x its true value), causing that bubble to render far larger than it should while the table still lists 790.
